status: Post-result extension chosen after viewing original Mamba/S4D outcomes; frozen before new outer evaluation; not a preregistered independent confirmation
input: 20 features; velocity zeroed BEFORE extraction for every instrument, no teacher or audio-side inference inputs
split: four outer piece/duplicate-group folds; inner 20% of remaining groups for validation; seed 20260911
selection: minimum validation loss on eight deterministic windows per validation track; evaluation only after training
amp_head: direct Linear(512,1) plus softplus; no note pooling, attention, state-space encoder or note residual head
matched_training: same crop, objectives, batches, optimizer for both encoders; encoder size differs and is reported
baseline_models: note-level OLS with training-fitted per-instrument shape
statistics: paired bootstrap over unique piece/duplicate groups, 5000 resamples; no significance claims from initialization SD
resumption: atomic epoch checkpoints include model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, best score and completed epoch
scope: One independent standard neural baseline in four original folds. No hyperparameter search, ensemble, new data or whole MIDI-DDSP training.
gpu_sharing: Local RTX 5070 Laptop only; one experiment training process; allocator cap 80%; >=2048 MiB free before launch; no auto-restart or device switching
prespecified_interpretation: Report all four primary metrics and paired group intervals, whether supporting or contradicting original diagnostic observations; same sensitivity grid and deduplicated comparison
